cards.title: A student-run credit union
cards.body: President of [Carolina Students’ Financial](https://carolinastudentsfinancial.org), working to charter the only not-for-profit financial institution run by students at a public university. A team of 45 has raised $406K in equity and $1.65M in deposit pledges.

cards.title: Climate policy, with an LLM
cards.body: Research and Policy Analyst at UNC’s [Data-Driven EnviroLab](https://datadrivenlab.org/), building a language model to read heat action plans from cities worldwide and surface what works.

cards.title: For the public good
cards.body: Working with Innovate Carolina’s [Design Innovation for the Public Good](https://innovate.unc.edu/design-and-innovation-for-the-public-good/) office while finishing an accelerated Master of Public Policy in Policy Design and Innovation.
